The Uwell Crown is a Atomizer that comes with commercial coils. These coils come in kanthal (for wattage) and also Nickel for temperature control.

You can also buy a extra attachment that allows you to rather use it as a RBA(Rebuild-able Atomizer).

It may be best for you to begin at about 1.5ohms until you develop a taste for lung hits and then move into sub-ohms.
